--- ## Walkthrough This PR updates a pathological event matcher used in monitoring tests. The `PodAutoscalerFailedToGetCPUUtilization` event detector now targets `openshift-ingress` and `e2e-*` namespaces instead of `horizontalpodautoscaler`, while maintaining the same failure reason and error message matching criteria. ## Changes **CPU Utilization Event Matcher** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Namespace pattern update for CPU utilization matcher**
`pkg/monitortestlibrary/pathologicaleventlibrary/duplicated_event_patterns.go`|The `PodAutoscalerFailedToGetCPUUtilization` matcher's `LocatorNamespaceKey` regex is updated from `horizontalpodautoscaler` to `^(openshift-ingress|e2e-.*)$`, while preserving the `FailedGetResourceMetric` reason and CPU utilization failure message match.| 🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes
